ablation.name: phase4c_blockmask_r60_b128_lvl2
ablation.notes: Phase 4C.1 MAIN: RGB block masking (ratio=0.6, block_size=128) + 2-Level DWT lowpass. User plan 6: Block Masking on RGB image. Black out 60% of 128x128 blocks in RGB before DINO encode. Prevents content leakage (structure destroyed) while preserving texture (continuous strokes survive). Combines with Phase 4D.1 lvl2 (SOTA clip=0.7301).
